QuestInfo.name: Alchemy is the Key!
QuestInfo.0: #p2151009# sounds really excited, and that makes you nervous. After the tail fur incident, what could Mastema want?
QuestInfo.2: #p2151009# crafted a transforming potion by mixing chemicals into #t4000419#. This will supposedly let Mastema change form. After drinking the potion, #p2151009# certainly changed form, but into you! And then Mastema changed right back! Guess this was a failure, as well...
QuestInfo.1: #p2151009# heard a rumor about some kind of alchemy that can change things any way you like. Since #m261000000# is well-known for alchemy, collect a #r#t4000419##k from #r#o9800045##k, who is in #bZenumist #m261010003##k, and bring it to Mastema.
